mapper.insert: insert into repair_record (application_id, asset_id, description, repair_company, fee, result, repair_time, create_time, update_time, create_user) values (#{applicationId}, #{assetId}, #{description}, #{repairCompany}, #{fee}, #{result}, #{repairTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser})
mapper.select:
select r.id, r.application_id, a.application_no, r.asset_id, ast.code as asset_code, ast.name as asset_name, r.description, r.repair_company, r.fee, r.result, r.repair_time, r.create_time from repair_record r left join asset_application a on r.application_id = a.id left join asset ast on r.asset_id = ast.id
and a.application_no like concat('%', #{applicationNo}, '%')
and a.employee_id = #{employeeId}
order by r.create_time desc
